description.value:
Mind Body Switch Technique. The Yamanaka clan's signature. You fire a phantom thread of chakra at a creature within 60 feet, sending your consciousness into theirs.

Your body collapses unconscious (and helpless) where it stood; you puppet the target instead. The target attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and you snap back to your body, becoming stunned 1.

Success You enter the target's body but the connection is so strained that you spend the duration unable to do anything but Move and Speak.

Failure You inhabit the target completely for up to 1 minute (you must Sustain each round). You can use the target's actions, including Strikes and any non-spell skill checks; you cannot cast their jutsu or use their class-DC abilities. The target retains their senses but is fully aware of being puppeted.

Critical Failure As failure, plus when the duration ends the target is stunned 1 from the disorientation.

If your unconscious body takes damage, you snap back immediately, ending the jutsu.

system.requirements: your body is in a defensible position
